about_summary_menu_bar: How much of each AI plan you have left — Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and many more — right in the menu bar, with reset times and pacing so a limit never catches you mid-task.
about_summary_tray: How much of each AI plan you have left — Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and many more — right in the system tray, with reset times and pacing so a limit never catches you mid-task.
alert_threshold_hint: Notify when a fresh usage reading reaches this percentage.
always_show_pacing_hint: Show the pace note on every metric. Off, only rows near their limit show it.
antigravity_start_hint: Open the Antigravity app or an agy session, then Refresh.
customize_prompt_hint: Turn on Customize to choose what to show.
error_recovery_hint: Try Refresh. If it keeps happening, Open TUI.
global_shortcut_hint: Show or hide this popover from any app.
installing_new_version: Installing the new version. AI Usage restarts by itself.
installing_version: Installing {version}. AI Usage restarts by itself.
menu_bar_shows_hint: Both show the metrics you star in each provider.
mit_license_summary: MIT — free to use, change and share
new_version_ready: The new version of AI Usage is ready to install.
new_version_uninstallable: A new version of AI Usage is out. It can't install itself here, so get it from the release page.
no_providers_enabled_hint: No providers enabled. Open the TUI and turn one on in Settings.
no_usage_or_balance_data_yet: No usage or balance data yet.
open_tui_settings_to_add_one: Open TUI → Settings to add one.
open_tui_settings_to_sign_in: Open TUI → Settings to sign in.
open_tui_settings_to_turn_one_on: Open TUI → Settings to turn one on.
pace_by_reset: On this pace, {percent}% of the quota is used by the reset
pace_shows_after_first: The pace shows after the first {duration} of each window.
popover_style_hint: Classic shows solid cards with pacing and reset details. Native follows your system's look: glass on macOS, Fluent on Windows.
quota_alerts_hint: System notifications for quota limits and expiring reset credits.
ready_to_install: AI Usage {version} is ready to install.
refresh_interval_hint: How often the tray fetches a fresh reading from each provider.
refresh_to_detect_hint: Refresh to check your installed providers.
reset_times_hint: Countdown reads “Resets in 6d”. Exact time reads the clock, like “today at 6:38 PM”.
same_readings_power: The same readings power the ai-usagebar CLI, the terminal TUI and the Waybar, GNOME and KDE widgets.
shortcut_recording_hint: Press the new shortcut, Escape to cancel
show_usage_as_hint: Used fills the bar with what is spent. Left fills it with what remains.
time_format_hint: Auto follows the system clock. 12-hour and 24-hour pin exact reset times.
turn_on_a_provider_in_customize: Turn on a provider in Customize.
update_available_uninstallable: AI Usage {version} is out. It can't install itself here, so get it from the release page.
update_check_no_answer: The update check did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
updates_hint: Automatic installs a release when it is found. Notify shows a banner. Off stops the hourly check.
usage_goal_hint: Show a goal based on time elapsed in each usage window. Monthly goals may be estimated.
welcome_hint: We turned on the providers that have credentials on this PC. Add or hide providers any time.
you_have_no_rate_limit_resets: You have no rate limit resets
